message: バザールでおじゃーる

name: Nanaka
message: 「We collected quite a lot of unwanted items!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All right!」

name: Ria
message: 「Amazing, amazing, there's even more than last year」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a bumper harvest and a big catch~♪」

name: Misa
message: 「What's with spacing out like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah. I was just thinking about something」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What, what, did you come up with some fun idea!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Since I know a lot of people there by sight, I'm pretty familiar with the shopping district, but... I realized it's surprisingly unknown」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah. I only go there once in a while myself, so today was fun with all the different discoveries」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to know more and more!!」

name: Synn
message: 「The fact that the shopping district folks are willing to help out means they care about our school, right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Everyone's so easygoing. If you ask them, 'Wanna set up a stall at the school?' they'd jump right on board」

name: Ria
message: 「Stalls, huh~~. It sounds fun if the school is lined with tons of shops」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. That's it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's up?」

name: Synn
message: 「How about we ask the shopping district folks to participate in the Charity Bazaar too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmph?」

name: Synn
message: 「Since the shopping district is right nearby, I want our students to get to know it better and shop there more」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So basically, it's good publicity for the shops, and it'll liven things up for the academy」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~~ I see!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold it right there!!」

name: Misa
message: 「This is a charity event, you know? Getting too commercial strays from the original purpose, I think」

name: Ria
message: 「Then couldn't we just put the stall fees toward the donations?」

name: Synn
message: 「Or even a portion of their sales, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, would the shopping district merchants agree to having money taken from them?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Rolo-chan.

name: Nanaka
message: That's what you call an 'advertising expense'!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oooh~」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, not every single one of them is necessarily going to go along with it」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why we just need to look for shops willing to cooperate and approach them」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For most shops, one word from the top settles it!」

name: Ria
message: 「A real community-based festival, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Naturally, my family's place is joining in too! Yuugiri-an, Ryuusei Academy branch. We're gonna donate all our sales!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How generous of you, Madam Treasurer♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, isn't that something your dad has to decide, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's fine! Just leave it to me!」

name: Ria
message: 「But Synn-kun. To pull this off, we have to hold a 'General Assembly'......」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It means that to decide on something this important, the whole student body has to properly discuss it together」

name: Synn
message: 「The Student General Assembly is next month, huh. The bazaar will be over by then......」

name: Misa
message: 「Student Council Bylaws, Article 14--」

name: Misa
message: 「When the executive board deems it necessary to deliberate on important matters concerning the council's activities, or upon request by one-fourth or more of all members......」

name: Misa
message: 「An extraordinary Student General Assembly may be convened」

name: Misa
message: 「So let's put together the agenda by then. Something that all the students will properly approve of」

name: Ria
message: 「Whoa... Misa-chan, that's wonderful\s05」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No, it's nothing like that...\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh. So you weren't against it after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course not. I was just making sure it wasn't a half-baked idea.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-W-What did you say--!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen well, Nanaka-san. Once we, the Ryuusei Student Council, approve something, we will see it through no matter what.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, bring it on!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. Let's see who can come up with the better agenda item... It's a contest!!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, let's just work together on this.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's the spirit, that's the spirit. We're finally starting to feel like a real Student Council.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Things are going to get tough from here on out, but a sparkling school life is definitely waiting for us beyond that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Honestly, just pulling this off is gonna make everything sparkle! I'm totally inviting a cake shop!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aah... So many shops, so many dreams.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And what's more, the fact that it'll tie into a fundraising drive is just so wonderful!!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not set in stone yet, so we all have to do our best, okay\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!! Leave it to me!」
